info.name: Voice Agent Portal API (D1–D6)
info.description:
Customer portal backend — NestJS/Fastify. Har workspace-scoped request par `Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}` (Auth0 customer tenant access token) aur `X-Workspace-Id: {{workspace_id}}` jaata hai. Errors hamesha `{code, message, fields?[]}`. Long operations `202 {job_id}` dete hain — SSE ya `GET /jobs/:id` se follow karo.

Setup: environment import karo → `base_url` aur `access_token` bharo → `POST /workspaces` chalao (workspace_id auto-set) → `GET /voices` (voice_id auto-set) → `POST /agents` (agent_id auto-set) → PATCH draft → generate (job_id auto-set) → GET /jobs/:id → publish.

**D6 (knowledge, numbers, activation, billing) ka pura raasta:**
1. `POST /agents/:id/knowledge` (folder 6) — source add, `status` `ready` hone tak poll.
2. `PUT /agents/:id/phone-plan` (folder 7) — Option A/B/C choose.
3. `POST /wallet/checkout` (folder 9) — pack kharido; `agent_id` doge toh paid webhook khud activation shuru kar dega.
4. `POST /agents/:id/activate` (folder 8) — ya khud trigger karo; `activation_id` auto-set.
5. `GET /agents/:id/activation` poll ya `curl -N /events?topics=activation:<id>` — `live` tak.
6. `GET /numbers` — number `active`, `e164` mil gaya. Ab us number par call aa sakti hai.

Activation ke saare guards asli hain: paid purchase nahi toh number nahi (§5.4), plan ka `max_numbers`, lint errors, paused workspace.

exec: // Har response par: error envelope §16 shape ka hona chahiye

item.name: 0 · Health & Config
item.description: Bina token ke chalne waale routes (health, pricing) aur workspace ka flags read.

request.description: Server zinda hai ya nahi. Compose healthcheck aur load balancer isko hit karte hain. Koi token nahi chahiye.

Packs (Starter/Growth/Scale/Pro), per-minute rates aur plan caps. Public route — pricing page bina login ke dikhti hai. `?region=ca` se region-restricted packs filter hote hain. Prices kabhi hard-code nahi hote, `pricing_configs` table se aate hain.

item.name: GET /flags — feature flags for this workspace

request.description: Is workspace ke liye resolved feature flags + kill switches (`flags:{ws}` cache, 60 s TTL). Portal isse decide karta hai kaunse buttons dikhane hain.

item.name: 1 · Workspaces (A4, D6)
item.description: Workspace = tenant = ek business. Sab billable cheez workspace ki hoti hai, user ki nahi.

request.description:
Signup ke baad pehla step. Ek transaction mein: tenants row (plan trial), owner membership, 20 trial credits (credit_ledger), default notification_settings, audit row. Same naam se double-click karo toh wahi workspace wapas milta hai (koi doosra trial grant nahi). `X-Workspace-Id` nahi chahiye — abhi workspace bana hi nahi. Verified email chahiye.

**Test script `workspace_id` env mein save kar deta hai.**

Signed-in user jis-jis workspace ka member hai uski list, role ke saath. Workspace switcher ke liye. Agar registration webhook miss hua tha toh yeh pehli request `users` row bhi provision kar deti hai (token ke `https://portal/email` claim se).
`X-Workspace-Id` header waale workspace ki detail, caller ke apne role ke saath.

D6 Settings: naam, timezone, website, business hours, recording default, retention days, onboarding step. Plan/credits/ownership yahan se kabhi nahi badalte. Audit row likhta hai aur runtime cache refresh karta hai (business hours `num:{e164}` mein jaate hain).
Onboarding checklist DB se compute hoti hai (workspace_created, agent_created, agent_generated, agent_published, complete…), client se nahi.
Ownership kisi existing member ko do. Demote + promote ek transaction mein, isliye kabhi do owner nahi hote (`memberships_one_owner_idx`).

item.name: 2 · Members & Invites (§6.1, A8)
item.description: Roles: owner / admin / editor / viewer. Exactly ek owner.

request.description: Workspace ke sab members role ke saath. Har role dekh sakta hai.
Member ka role badlo (admin/editor/viewer). Owner ka role yahan se nahi badal sakta — uske liye transfer-ownership.
Member hatao. Owner ko hataana refuse hota hai — bina owner workspace unrecoverable hai.
Abhi tak accept na hue invites. Owner/admin only.

Email + role. Token sirf **ek baar** response mein aata hai (DB mein sirf hash). Same email ko dobara invite karo toh purana token replace hota hai. Owner role invite se nahi diya ja sakta.

**Test script `invite_id` aur `invite_token` save karta hai.**
Pending invite cancel karo.
Invitee token se join karta hai. `X-Workspace-Id` nahi hota (abhi member nahi hai) — token hi authorisation hai, aur signed-in email invite ke email se match hona chahiye. Expired token refuse.

item.name: 3 · Templates & Agents (W1–W3, D3)
item.description: Agent create, brief autosave, versions, publish, pause/resume, delete.

request.description: §9.2 ke 7 templates (receptionist, appointment, afterhours, lead_qual, faq_support, restaurant, custom). `brief_prefill` yahan nahi aata — woh agent create par v1 mein jaata hai. Table row ho toh table, warna `templates/*.json` file.

Agent + uska v1 draft (template ke brief prefill aur default tier ke saath) + audit row, ek transaction mein. Retell ko abhi kuch nahi bhejte — Retell objects pehle generate par lazily bante hain.

**Test script `agent_id` save karta hai.**
Workspace ke agents, cursor pagination (`?cursor=&limit=`), optional `?status=draft|live|paused`. Summary mein tier/voice/max_duration **live** values hain.

Summary + `draft` version + `published` version. `draft.settings` = jo customer bana raha hai; top-level `tier`/`voice_id` = jo phone pe live hai aur bill hota hai. Dono alag ho sakte hain jab tak publish na ho.

Wizard ka autosave (debounced 1.5 s) aur D3 Brief/Voice tabs. `brief` field-by-field merge hota hai — ek textarea bhejo toh baaki 12 fields blank nahi hote. `tier`, `voice_id`, `max_call_duration_s`, `languages` **draft version** mein jaate hain, live agent par nahi — billing rate publish tak nahi badalta. Draft frozen ho (published/overtaken) toh naya version fork hota hai. Sirf `name`/`industry` live update hote hain. Koi LLM call nahi.

item.name: POST /agents/:id/draft/select — restore a version as draft (§13.5 Undo)

request.description: Sirf pointer move: `draft_version` ko purane version par point karo. Koi nayi row nahi, koi LLM nahi. Purana version phir bhi immutable rehta hai — agli edit fork karegi.
Sab versions newest first, `is_draft`/`is_published` flags, source (generated/feedback/manual/regenerate), changes list.

Ek version ka pura detail: brief, `prompt_text` (guardrails ke saath, read-only), `editable_prompt` (guardrails hataake, Advanced editor ke liye), greeting/closing, brief_card, scenarios, lint, `settings`. Koi Retell identifier nahi.

Manual prompt edit → **naya** version (source=manual), base version untouched. Body mein sirf editable prompt jaata hai; §9.4 platform guardrails server strip karke canonical block append karta hai — customer unhe hata/badal nahi sakta. Result lint hota hai.

Synchronous. Lint (errors block, warnings pass) → publish lease claim → Retell LLM/agent sync + publish → `published_version` + version ki settings agents par copy (tier/voice/duration ab live + billable) → audit → runtime cache refresh → SSE. Idempotent (`already_published: true`). Paused agent paused hi rehta hai. Body khaali = draft publish; `version_no` de kar purana version rollback. Stack config missing ho toh `503 NOT_CONFIGURED`.
Local state change + runtime cache refresh; Retell call nahi — Retell down ho toh bhi customer apna agent rok sakta hai. Idempotent. Owner/admin.
Sirf published agent resume ho sakta hai. Owner/admin.

`deleted_at` set hota hai (calls billing history hain, row nahi jaati), Retell objects destroy hote hain. Phone number attached ho ya call chal rahi ho toh `409 AGENT_IN_USE`. Response sirf `{deleted}` — Retell errors audit mein, wire par nahi.

item.name: 4 · Prompting & Jobs (§13.3, §13.5, §16)
item.description: LLM waale routes 202 + job_id dete hain; kabhi model ka wait nahi karte.

request.description:
W2 Generate. Brief complete hai ya nahi check (about_business/goal ≥ 20 chars), workspace paused nahi, `pause_generation` kill switch off — phir `jobs` row + BullMQ `prompting` queue → `202 {job_id}`. Worker: provider → zod → guardrails append → lint → immutable version → Retell draft sync → SSE `generated`. Double click = same job_id (one-active-job index). `mode: regenerate` purana feedback carry karta hai. Editor+ aur verified email.

**Test script `job_id` save karta hai.**

§9.6: 10–500 chars ka feedback → naya version (source=feedback) with `changes[]`. Guardrail se conflict kare toh `changes: []` + explanation, prompt wahi rehta hai. `base_version` optional (default draft).

SSE na ho toh har 3 s poll. Response whitelisted `progress` (agent_id, mode, base_version, version_no, changes, refused, explanation, lint_findings) + `status` + customer-safe `error`. Internal `steps_json` (provider, model, Retell sync) kabhi nahi aata. Doosre workspace ka job = 404.

item.name: 5 · Voices (W3)
item.description: Retell voice catalogue, `voices` table mein cached (daily job).

request.description:
Filters: `lang` (en, fr-CA…), `gender`, `tier`, `multilingual`. Yahi ids `voice_id` mein PATCH draft ko bhejte hain — unknown id `400` deta hai.

**Test script pehli voice ka id `voice_id` mein save karta hai.**

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); const first = (b.items || b.voices || b)[0]; if (first && first.voice_id) pm.environment.set('voice_id', first.voice_id);

request.description: Voice ka sample clip URL. Abhi `kind: sample` (provider ka fixed clip); `text` se synthesize Phase 2.

item.name: 6 · Knowledge — what your agent knows (W4, §13.1)
item.description:
W4 "aapka agent kya jaanta hai". Teen tarah ke source: **url**, **file** (base64 JSON me), **text**.

Route sirf row banata hai (`status: pending`) aur `provisioning` queue par `knowledge-sync` job daalta hai → **202**. Worker voice platform par ek knowledge base per agent banata/dhoondta hai, source add karta hai, ingestion poll karta hai (~12 s), phir `ready` ya `failed`. File/text ke bytes DB me `payload` column me sirf ingest hone tak rehte hain, uske baad NULL.

Gates: plan me `knowledge_base` feature chahiye + `caps.kb_allowance` (ek agent = ek KB ginta hai). Limits: 20 source per agent, file ≤ 20 MB, private/loopback URL refuse. Writes Editor+; read sabko.

Dono shapes same resource hain: `/agents/:id/knowledge` (spec §16) aur `/knowledge` (body me `agent_id`).

request.description:
Sabse seedha source: plain text. `name` mandatory, `text` 1–200 000 chars.

Kya hota hai: row `pending` → job queue → platform KB me ek `text` source (title me row id ke pehle 8 hex daale jaate hain, taaki retry ke waqt wahi source dobara dhoondha ja sake, duplicate na bane) → ingest complete → `ready`, `synced_at` set, `payload` NULL.

**Response me platform ka koi id nahi** — `retell_source_id` server-side rehta hai.

**Test script `source_id` save karta hai.**

exec: if (body && body.id !== undefined && body.id !== null) pm.environment.set('source_id', body.id);

request.description:
URL source. `name` optional — na do toh hostname+path se ban jaata hai (`example.com/faq`).

Validation: sirf http(s); `localhost`, `127.*`, `10.*`, `192.168.*`, `169.254.*` (AWS metadata), `*.internal`, credentials waale URL (`https://user:pw@…`) **400** — platform apne network se page fetch karta hai, isliye SSRF ka rasta band.

Platform ek page crawl karta hai (deep crawl nahi). Idempotency key yahan URL khud hai: retry pe same URL mil gaya toh dobara add nahi hota.

exec: if (body && body.id !== undefined && body.id !== null) pm.environment.set('source_id', body.id);

request.description:
File source. Portal static export hai (apna upload service nahi), isliye bytes **base64** me JSON body me aate hain.

`content_type` allowed list se: pdf, plain, markdown, csv, doc, docx — aur kuch bhi **422** (zod). Decode ke baad size check: khaali file ya > 20 MB **400**. Platform par filename `<row id ke 8 hex>-<name>.<ext>` jaata hai — wahi retry ka lookup key hai.

`size_bytes` decode ke baad ka real size hota hai, base64 ka nahi.

exec: if (body && body.id !== undefined && body.id !== null) pm.environment.set('source_id', body.id);

request.description:
Is agent ke saare sources, purane se naye. Har row: `type`, `name`, `url`, `status`, `size_bytes`, `synced_at`, aur `error` (sirf jab `status = failed`, aur wo ek customer-safe line hoti hai — platform ka error text `sync_json` me server-side rehta hai).

Doosre workspace ka agent id → **404** (RLS + explicit tenant filter).

exec: if (body && (body[0] && body[0].id) !== undefined && (body[0] && body[0].id) !== null) pm.environment.set('source_id', (body[0] && body[0].id));

request.description: Wahi list, workspace-level route se. `agent_id` hata do toh poore workspace ke saare sources aate hain (D3 Knowledge tab ke liye).
Ek source ka detail. Polling ke liye yahi route hai — W4 isko tab tak poll karta hai jab tak `status` `ready`/`failed` na ho jaaye.
Same create, lekin agent path me nahi body me. Dono routes ek hi service call karte hain — jo UI ke liye convenient ho wo use karo.

exec: if (body && body.id !== undefined && body.id !== null) pm.environment.set('source_id', body.id);

request.description:
Do raaste, response batata hai kaunsa chala:

- Source platform tak pahuncha hi nahi tha → row seedhe delete → `{deleted: true, pending: false}`.
- Source platform par hai → row `deleting` me park + job → **pehle** platform copy delete, **phir** row → `{deleted: false, pending: true}`.

Order jaan-boojh kar ye hai: row pehle delete karte toh customer ko lagta "hata diya" jabki agent abhi bhi us knowledge se jawab de raha hota.
Wahi delete, agent path ke bina.

item.name: 7 · Phone plan & Numbers (W6, §11, §13.8)
item.description:
W6 par customer number ka **option** chunta hai (plan), aur payment ke baad activation job usko **execute** karta hai.

- **A `new`** — hum naya number kharidte hain (US/CA only).
- **B `forward`** — hum naya number kharidte hain, customer apni purani line usme forward karta hai (carrier codes hum dete hain).
- **C `sip`** — customer apna SIP trunk laata hai; password envelope-encrypted hota hai.
- **D `port`** — abhi refuse (P3).

Ek agent par ek hi `pending` plan (partial unique index) — dobara PUT karoge toh wahi row update hoti hai.

Wizard ke bahar (D4 "Add number") seedhe `POST /numbers/buy` / `/import` hai — wo apna `phone_numbers` row banake `provision-number` job queue karta hai.

request.description:
Option A. `country` US/CA (ADR 0003 §4 — platform sirf yahi bechta hai), `area_code` optional 3 digit, `toll_free` optional.

Routing bhi yahin baithti hai: `hours_mode` (`always` | `business` = workspace hours | `custom` = apna schedule), `transfer_targets` (max 5), `allowed_countries` (inbound country whitelist).

Yahan **koi paisa nahi** lagta aur platform ko kuch nahi jaata — ye sirf "customer ne kya choose kiya" ka record hai. Paid purchase ka check activation ke `provision` step par hota hai, kyunki W6 wizard me W7 (payment) se pehle aata hai.

**Test script `plan_id` save karta hai.**

exec: if (body && body.id !== undefined && body.id !== null) pm.environment.set('plan_id', body.id);

request.description:
Option B. Number phir bhi hum hi kharidte hain; farak ye hai ki customer apni **purani** line (`existing_number`) us naye number par forward karega, aur `carrier` batata hai ki hum kaunsi dial-code guide dikhaayein.

Important: hum carrier forwarding **provision nahi kar sakte** — wo customer ke haath me hai. Isliye number active hone ke baad bhi `forwarding.status = waiting_for_customer` rehta hai jab tak customer `PATCH /numbers/:id {forwarding_confirmed: true}` na kare. Agent naye number par live hota hai — forwarding uske upar ka step hai.

exec: if (body && body.id !== undefined && body.id !== null) pm.environment.set('plan_id', body.id);

request.description:
Option C. `sip.number` (E.164), `sip.host` (termination URI, `sip.example.com` ya `sip:pbx.example.com:5060`), optional username/password.

**Password kabhi plain store nahi hota** (§17): har secret ke liye naya AES-256-GCM data key banta hai, wo key KMS se wrap hoti hai (staging/prod) ya local master se (dev/test), aur plan id AAD hai — matlab envelope ko dusri row me copy karoge toh decrypt hi nahi hoga.

Response me sirf `{number, host, username, has_password}` — envelope bhi nahi. Decrypt sirf ek jagah hota hai: platform ko `import-phone-number` bhejne se theek pehle, stack par, aur wahin khatam.

Gate: plan me `sip_import` chahiye (Scale+) warna **400 PLAN_LIMIT**. Server par KMS/local key configured na ho toh **503 NOT_CONFIGURED**.

item.name: GET /agents/:id/phone-plan — abhi kya chuna hua hai

request.description: Pending plan (ya agar koi pending nahi toh last executed). `number_id` tab bharta hai jab activation ne is plan se number bana diya ho. SIP password yahan bhi nahi aata — `sip.has_password` bas boolean.

D4 Numbers list. Har row: `e164` (provisioning ke dauraan `null` — platform hi number chunta hai), `kind` (`bought` | `sip`; telephony vendor ka naam kabhi nahi), `status` (`provisioning|active|paused|releasing|released|failed`), `paused`, routing, `forwarding` (Option B), `rental_credits` + `next_rental_at` (§5.3 15 credits/month), aur `error` sirf `failed` par.

exec: if (body && (body[0] && body[0].id) !== undefined && (body[0] && body[0].id) !== null) pm.environment.set('number_id', (body[0] && body[0].id));

request.description:
Option B ke liye dial codes. `carrier`: bell | rogers | telus | videotron | att | verizon | tmobile | other. `destination` (optional) naya number — steps me `{destination}` uski jagah bhar jaata hai; na do toh "your new number" likha aata hai.

Zyadatar North American carriers: on `*72` + number, off `*73`; T-Mobile `**21*<number>#` / `##21#`. Ye content hai, code nahi — carrier code badle toh ek line ka edit hai.

item.name: POST /numbers/buy — wizard ke bahar naya number (202)

request.description:
D4 "Add number" (Option A/B). Pehle refuse karta hai agar: koi paid purchase nahi (**402 NO_CREDITS**, §5.4 "pehli purchase se pehle koi number nahi"), balance ≤ 0, ya plan ke `max_numbers` se upar (**400 PLAN_LIMIT**).

Phir `phone_numbers` row `provisioning` me banti hai aur `provision-number` job queue hota hai → **202 {number, job_id}** (`job_id` = row id). Worker: pehle platform par `num-<row id ke 20 hex>` nickname dhoondta hai (taaki timeout ke baad dobara na kharide), na mile toh kharidta hai, `e164` turant save, phir bind (agent → `latest_published` + hamara inbound webhook) → `active` → runtime cache refresh.

`forward_from` + `carrier` do toh yahi Option B ban jaata hai. Owner/admin + verified email.

**Test script `number_id` save karta hai.**

exec: if (body && body.number && body.number.id !== undefined && body.number && body.number.id !== null) pm.environment.set('number_id', body.number && body.number.id);

request.description:
Option C wizard ke bahar. `sip_import` gate + KMS/local key zaroori. Password yahin seal hota hai (plan row banti hai `executed` status me, kyunki ye W6 ka choice nahi, is import ka record hai), phir `phone_numbers` row `provisioning`, phir job.

Worker: pehle `get-phone-number(e164)` — agar pehle se import ho chuka hai toh usse adopt kar leta hai (double import nahi), warna `import-phone-number` with decrypted password. SIP numbers ka `rental_credits = 0` (§5.3 — BYO SIP free).

Wahi number kisi aur active number ke roop me maujood ho toh **409 NUMBER_IN_USE**.

exec: if (body && body.number && body.number.id !== undefined && body.number && body.number.id !== null) pm.environment.set('number_id', body.number && body.number.id);

request.description: Ek number ka detail. Provisioning ke dauraan poll karne ke liye — `status` `provisioning` → `active` (ya `failed` + `error`).

Sirf wahi fields mutable hain jo mutable honi chahiye: `nickname`, `hours_mode`/`hours_override`, `transfer_targets`, `allowed_countries`, `blocklist`, `paused`, `forwarding_confirmed`, aur `agent_id`.

`e164`, number ka type, inbound token — request shape me hain hi nahi, isliye unhe bheja toh **422** ("nothing to update").

`agent_id` badla toh: naya agent published hona chahiye (warna **400**), local row update hoti hai, aur platform par binding bhi re-point hoti hai (ek call, transaction ke bahar). Har edit ke baad `num:{e164}` runtime cache refresh hota hai — warna hot path purane hours/blocklist se decide karta rehta.

`paused: true` = number turant answer karna band (cache me `number_paused`), platform ko chhua bhi nahi jaata — isliye platform down ho tab bhi customer apna number chup kara sakta hai.

Customer ne carrier par `*72` dial kar diya → ye bhejo. `forwarding.status` `waiting_for_customer` → `ready`.

Jis number par `forwarding_from` hai hi nahi, uspar bhejoge toh **400**.

Order maayne rakhta hai: row `releasing` → cache refresh (turant answer karna band) → **platform par number release** → row `released` + `released_at`, agent detach. Row delete nahi hoti kyunki `calls` usko reference karte hain aur calls billing history hai (§17).

Live call chal raha ho toh **409 NUMBER_IN_USE**. Dobara DELETE = `{released: false}` (idempotent). Platform pehle hi 404 de de toh usko "already gone" maan kar aage badhta hai.

Ulta order (row pehle) jaan-boojh kar nahi kiya — warna paid number platform par chhoot jaata aur bill aata rehta.

item.name: 8 · Activation — go live (W7, §13.8)
item.description:
Payment ke baad ka poora flow, ek durable step machine ki tarah:

```
publish → provision → bind → mark_live → notify
```

Ye ek `jobs` row hai (`type = activate-agent`) jiska `steps_json` har step ka outcome store karta hai **agla step shuru hone se pehle**. Worker mar jaaye toh wo pehle aise step se resume karta hai jo `completed`/`skipped` nahi hai — isliye number kharid ke crash hua toh dobara **nahi** kharidta, seedhe bind karta hai.

**Agent `live` sirf `mark_live` par hota hai, aur wo `bind` ke baad hi aata hai** — kabhi aisa nahi ho sakta ki agent live dikhe aur number usable na ho.

Retry: 3 attempts. Retryable = platform 5xx/429/408/409, network, Postgres. Permanent (pehle hi attempt par fail) = lint error, plan nahi, paid purchase nahi, plan limit, platform 4xx. Teenon attempt fail → workflow `FAILED` + number row `failed` + ek `failed` SSE frame + ek ops alert (secrets redacted).

Do entry points: ye route, ya W7 ka paid `checkout.session.completed` jisme `agent_id` tha (billing announce karta hai, activation sunta hai).

request.description:
Owner/admin + verified email. Workspace paused ho toh **403**; agent ke paas koi version hi na ho toh **400 BRIEF_INCOMPLETE**.

`version_no` optional — na do toh draft publish hota hai.

Response **202 {job_id}** — yahi `activation_id` bhi hai. Dubara click = wahi job_id (one-active-job-per-agent partial index). Agar purana job worker ke marne se atak gaya tha toh wo write-off hokar naya job milta hai.

Steps detail:
1. **publish** — wahi `AgentPublishService` jo `POST /publish` use karta hai: lease, lint, Retell version publish, live columns copy. Pehle se published ho toh `already_published` — kuch nahi badalta.
2. **provision** — pending plan dhoondo (ya already active number ho toh ye aur bind dono `skipped`), billing check (paid purchase + balance + max_numbers), row banao, number kharido/import karo.
3. **bind** — platform par number → agent `latest_published` + hamara inbound webhook. Pehle padho, match kare toh update hi nahi.
4. **mark_live** — ek transaction me: `agents.status = live` (paused ho toh paused hi rehta hai), plan `executed`, `onboarding_completed_at`, audit row. Phir `num:{e164}` refresh.
5. **notify** — `agent:{id}` par `activated` frame.

**Test script `activation_id` save karta hai.**

Body khaali `{}` bhej sakte ho (draft publish hoga). Specific version chahiye toh `{"version_no": 3}`.

exec: if (body && body.job_id !== undefined && body.job_id !== null) pm.environment.set('activation_id', body.job_id);

request.description:
Is agent ka sabse naya activation, customer-safe shape me:

`{activation_id, agent_id, status, step, progress, attempt, max_attempts, steps[], number_id, e164, forwarding, error, timestamps}`

`status`: `pending | publishing | provisioning | binding | marking_live | live | failed`. `progress` whole steps ka % (0/20/40/60/80/100).

Jo **nahi** aata: platform ke ids, `last_error`, `requested_by`, stack trace. `error` sirf fail hone par, aur wo ek line hai jo customer kuch kar sake ("Choose a phone number option…", "This version cannot go live yet.").
Wahi view, activation (job) id se. Doosre workspace ka id = **404**.
SSE na chal rahi ho toh har 3 s. `progress` me D6 ke liye char field aur hain: `activation_status`, `activation_step`, `number_id`, `e164`.

Live progress. Frames: `started` → `progress` (har step par ek) → `live` ya `failed`. Har frame ka `data` wahi `activationView` hai.

Postman SSE ko stream nahi karta (response buffer karta hai) — isliye isko cancel karke bhejo, ya `curl -N` use karo:

```sh
curl -N "$BASE/events?topics=activation:$ACTIVATION_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Workspace-Id: $WS"
```

`EventSource` deliberately use nahi hota — wo `Authorization`/`X-Workspace-Id` bhej hi nahi sakta (isliye frontend par `@microsoft/fetch-event-source`).

item.name: 9 · Wallet & Billing (§5.4, §13.7, D6 top-up/invoices/portal)
item.description:
Prepaid credits. 1 credit = 1 min Standard; Premium 1.5×.

D6: auto top-up (off-session PaymentIntent), invoices mirror aur Stripe Customer Portal session bhi yahin hain.

request.description: Balance (2 dp), last pack, low-balance thresholds, auto top-up settings. Balance = Σ credit_ledger.delta, `bal:{ws}` cache se.
Har purchase ka lot, expiry (12 months), remaining. FIFO consume hote hain.
Append-only ledger: trial, purchase, call debit, expiry, adjustment… `?reason=` filter, cursor pagination.

Stripe hosted Checkout URL return karta hai; credits Stripe webhook (`checkout.session.completed`, paid) par aate hain, response par nahi. `agent_id` do toh W7 par paid hote hi agent activate. Owner/admin + verified email.

Auto top-up on karo. Zaroori: `auto_topup` gate (pack ke saath aata hai) **aur** ek saved card — card tabhi save hota hai jab Checkout "keep my card" ke saath hua ho (`setup_future_usage=off_session`). Card na ho toh **400 NO_PAYMENT_METHOD**.

`threshold` credits me (min 10); na do toh pack ke `auto_topup_threshold_pct` (10%) se calculate ho jaata hai.

Chalega aise: har **debit** par (call bill hote hi) aur har 15 min ke schedule par balance check hota hai. Threshold se neeche gaya toh wallet lock ke andar pending purchase banti hai (guards: ek top-up already pending ho toh 30 min tak dobara nahi; card decline hua ho toh 6 ghante cooldown), phir off-session PaymentIntent banta hai `idempotencyKey = topup-<purchase id>` ke saath.

**Credits sirf tab milte hain jab Stripe confirm kare** — `payment_intent.succeeded` webhook par (ya schedule Stripe se intent retrieve karke), amount/currency match karke, wallet lock ke andar. PaymentIntent bana dene se koi credit nahi milta.

Response me `payment_method_id` aata hai par PAN kabhi nahi — sirf `card_last4`.
Band. Card aur pack yaad rehte hain (dobara on karna ek click ho), bas `enabled: false`.

Stripe invoices ka mirror, cursor-paginated. Har row: `number`, `amount_cents`, `currency`, `status`, `hosted_url`, `pdf_url`, `finalized_at`, `paid_at`.

`status`: `draft | open | paid | payment_failed | void | uncollectible`. `payment_failed` Stripe ka invoice status nahi hai (invoice `open` hi rehti hai) — wo event ka matlab hai, jo customer ke liye zyada sach hai.

Rows sirf `invoice.*` webhooks likhte hain, `stripe_invoice_id` par keyed. Out-of-order delivery se bachne ke liye status rank hai: `paid`/`void` ke baad `open` wapas nahi aata. Jis customer ka workspace map nahi hota wo row `tenant_id NULL` ke saath store hoti hai (reconciliation ke liye) aur kisi customer ko dikhti nahi.

Note: off-session auto top-up **invoice nahi** banata (Checkout banata hai), isliye top-up ke baad yahan nayi row zaroori nahi.

D5 "Payment methods". Owner/admin. Stripe customer **is workspace ki row se** padha jaata hai — request me customer id lene ka koi field hai hi nahi, isliye doosre workspace ka portal kholne ka rasta nahi.

`return_path` optional, sirf apne origin ka path (`/app/wallet…`); poora URL bhejoge toh **422** (schema regex). Kabhi kuch khareeda hi na ho toh Stripe customer hi nahi hota → **400 NO_PAYMENT_METHOD**.

Response `{url}` — us par redirect karo; card add/remove, receipts sab wahin.

Filters: status, channel, direction, agent_id, number_id, from/to, is_test. Declined inbound calls 'Missed' dikhte hain with decline_reason.

**Test script pehli call ka id `call_id` save karta hai.**

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.items && b.items[0]) pm.environment.set('call_id', b.items[0].id);

request.description: Transcript, analysis fields, duration, credits charged, rate captured at call time.
Call ko handled mark karo ya note likho. Kam se kam ek field chahiye. Editor+.

1-hour signed URL `…/recording/stream?token=` deta hai. Retell URL browser ko kabhi nahi milta. Owner/admin/editor (viewer ke liye §20 open).

**Test script `recording_token` save karta hai.**

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); const m = /token=([^&]+)/.exec(b.url || ''); if (m) pm.environment.set('recording_token', m[1]);

request.description: Audio bytes proxy karta hai (Range headers pass, seek chalta hai). Token hi credential hai — bearer nahi chahiye.
`range=today|7d|30d|custom` (custom ke saath from/to). Calls, minutes, credits spent, missed…

item.name: 11 · Events (SSE, §16)
item.description: Postman mein stream sirf khulti hai; frames dekhne ke liye browser/curl better hai.

request.description: Workspace ke topics: `wallet`, `agent:{id}`, `call:{id}`, `activation:{id}`. `?topics=` se narrow karo. Ordinary authenticated route — `EventSource` headers nahi bhej sakta isliye client `@microsoft/fetch-event-source` use karta hai. Server replay nahi karta; frame miss ho toh resource re-read karo.

item.name: 12 · Webhooks (public, provider-signed)
item.description:
Retell/Stripe/Auth0 ke liye. Bearer nahi — signature/secret hi credential hai. Postman se sirf auth webhook realistically test hota hai (shared secret); Retell/Stripe ko raw body par HMAC chahiye.

**D6:** Stripe endpoint ab `payment_intent.succeeded|payment_failed|canceled` (auto top-up) aur `invoice.created|finalized|paid|payment_failed|voided|marked_uncollectible` bhi handle karta hai. Dashboard endpoint ko bilkul `StripeEventHandler.HANDLED` waali list par subscribe karo — usme jo nahi hai wo store hokar ignore ho jaata hai.

request.description: Auth0 Post-User-Registration (`user.registered`) aur Post-Login (`user.login`) Actions yahan post karte hain, header `x-action-secret` = `AUTH0_CUSTOMER_ACTION_SECRET`. Store → 204 on duplicate → queue → 200; worker `users` upsert karta hai (idempotent on sub). Isse local user banao jab Auth0 nahi hai.

`call_started` / `call_ended` / `call_analyzed`. `x-retell-signature` = HMAC-SHA256(raw body, API key). Sirf `call_ended` credits move karta hai. Postman se signature manually compute karni padegi (pre-request script mein CryptoJS use karo).

Inbound call authorisation, Redis-only, p95 < 300 ms. Six checks (workspace paused, number paused, blocklist, balance, concurrency cap, hours). Allow = override agent + max_call_duration_ms; decline = `{call_inbound:{reject:true}}` (busy tone). Unknown number/bad signature = `200 {}` fail-open, kabhi 4xx nahi.

**D6:** `number_token` ab `POST /numbers/buy` / activation se banta hai (`phone_numbers.inbound_token`, `tok_<40 hex>`), aur platform par number ka `inbound_webhook_url` bind step me isi token par point kiya jaata hai.

`checkout.session.completed` (credit only when paid), `async_payment_succeeded/failed`, `expired`. `stripe-signature` header chahiye — Stripe CLI (`stripe listen --forward-to`) se test karo, Postman se realistic nahi.

Auto top-up ka **credit dene wala** event. Flow: verify signature (raw bytes) → `webhook_events` me store (`provider+external_id+event_type` unique) → **200 fast** → `webhooks` queue.

Handler: `metadata.kind = auto_topup` na ho toh ignore (Checkout ka PaymentIntent `checkout.session.completed` ka kaam hai). Purchase dhoondo (`metadata.purchase_id`, warna `stripe_payment_intent` unique index se), `pending` ho, amount+currency match kare — tab wallet lock ke andar `paid` + `topup` ledger row. Replay = `already_paid`, kuch nahi badalta.

Isko Postman se mat bhejo — signature asli chahiye. `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:4000/webhooks/stripe` chalao aur `stripe trigger payment_intent.succeeded`, ya `test/d6-billing.e2e.test.ts` dekho jo `signForTest()` se sign karta hai.

`invoices` table ka mirror. Idempotency do layer me: `webhook_events` (ek event id = ek baar process) aur `stripe_invoice_id` par upsert with `last_event_created` + status rank — isliye `invoice.finalized` `invoice.paid` ke **baad** aaye toh invoice `paid` hi rehti hai, `open` par wapas nahi jaati.

Workspace resolve: `metadata.workspace_id` (agar hamara hai) → warna `tenants.stripe_customer_id`. Na mile toh row `tenant_id NULL` ke saath rakh li jaati hai (SA9 reconciliation), customer ko dikhti nahi.
Retell web-call access token mint karta hai (agent_id + optional version). Staging/prod par 404. Draft test karne ke liye explicit `agent_version` do.
